latestHairCandidateStatus: Blender 官方 CC0 Long Hair 已離線烘焙、適配並綁定 v249；移除誤顯示的舊 scalp coverage 後，frame 1/20 靜態碰撞與五狀態共 1,122,300 個 runtime 髮點均為零穿模。balanced 動態為 222 guides、11,223 render curves、3.67 MiB、約 16.54 ms/frame、髮尾最大位移約 7.0 mm。11 視角顯示長度與後側重量優於 r84，但額角露白、髮根過稀與頭頂平行刷痕仍未達視覺門檻，因此不取代 r38 或網站 v83。
latestEyeCandidateStatus: editable upper/lower aperture shape key opens the vertical eye contour and regenerates 76 upper lashes from the evaluated skin surface; frame 1/20 static, 11-shot, and five-state dynamic audits pass while iris, sclera, and cornea overlaps decrease, but strict overall review remains about 53/100, so it is not promoted
latestFaceCandidateStatus: editable topology-based philtrum smoothing shape key reduces face self-intersections from 102/99 to 95/91 at frames 1/20 and reduces lip/wet-line overlaps; 11-shot and five-state dynamic audits pass, but the visible gain remains local and strict overall review remains about 52/100, so it is not promoted
latestSkinCandidateStatus: r75 calibrated skin response and fine-pore microrelief baked into an owned packed 4096x2048 tangent normal atlas; visual A/B, 11-shot, frame 1/20 static, and five-state 1,500,400-point dynamic audits pass, but strict overall visual review remains about 52/100 and is not promoted
latestRejectedReason: 以實際根點建立的 508 面 root-shadow 補片在左額角形成硬邊深色塊；loose 動態參數也曾在強轉向後拉出異常長髮絲，兩者皆依嚴格視覺檢查判退。
